description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Inspection Plan provides a way to interact with the [Inspection Plan API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_INSPECTIONPLAN_SRV/overview). The service allows to create, read, update and delete inspection plans, with their material assignments, operations, inspection characteristics, dependent characteristics and production resources and tools.
key-features: Create, read, update and delete inspection plans
Maintain material assignments, operations and the inspection characteristics of each operation
Maintain dependent characteristics and production resources and tools (PRTs)
